scope: Independent anonymous judge one, task T1 stage d0. Only approved inputs, referenced source capsules/common corpora/design sources and frozen candidate-v8 generic evaluator were read. No arm assignment, original self-review, other judgment, prohibited prior study, SDK or production change was used.

visual_inspection.method: Original immutable PNGs supplied by each observation were opened by PIL, hashed, viewport-cropped using native-to-image metadata, resampled to native-unit reading size, assembled without blending into full-content reading strips, and folded into labeled columns for visual inspection. All 56 state sheets were viewed. Native complete interval union is independent of the sheet assembly. Every sheet segment maps to its original index and offset in coverage.json. Source text and fixtures were checked against all visible blocks. The original P1 Android baseline and four original source-b iOS failure PNGs were additionally viewed directly. Approved reference PNGs were viewed, including a folded P2 reference for readable full-content inspection. No reference candidate was used as the design.
limits: The reading strips select non-overlapping portions from overlapping original viewports; they preserve full-state content but do not claim every redundant original frame was individually displayed. Initial/final/other action frames outside the exact selected-state sets were hashed but not separately scored.

Fold boundaries can cut a line visually; continuation in the next column and overlapping original frame evidence were used to distinguish those cuts from truncation. Native interval coverage, not footer existence, established completeness.

No invented font, glyph, effective padding, physical touch-area or unsampled surface measurements. All 28 iOS title-native-weight cells remain unsupported U after frozen recomputation. No unsupported geometry cell was promoted by appearance.
Only public P1/P2, LTR, delivered themes and native font settings are covered. This is not arbitrary-data, RTL, lifecycle, navigation, accessibility pronunciation/order or full-brief certification.

qualitative_findings: All required text is present in the inspected baseline/expanded/submitted states, including all six entries, verbatim disabled reasons, caller replacement notice and newly unavailable a reason, long summaries, the expanded global guidance, primary label and complete footer. Collapsed guidance was intentionally excluded.

Narrow enlarged iOS labels sometimes break Unavailable between characters; the brief explicitly allows character breaks when the segment cannot fit. The characters are preserved. This was not labeled clipping.

No visible text/control collisions or unintended overlap were found in the selected sweeps. Native container/primary boxes and all 13 named semantic targets per state were inspected and retained in bindings.json.

Source-b iOS disabled text and surfaces are visibly dimmed. The wrapping proposition explicitly evaluates line breaking only. Its true decision does not certify contrast or override the independent measured primary-fill failure.

failure_causes.cluster: One shared component disabled-rendering cause manifested in four state/case cells; not four independent bugs.
failure_causes.evidence: Original unique workshop.submit boxes are fully visible; normalized side strips are inside the actual painted button, glyph-free, with 100% uniform support in seven measured original frames. P1 renders #FFCFCDC5 and P2 #FF33474C in these regions, differing from the independently approved disabled fills. Frozen native_pixels recomputation and exact original hashes are retained in pixel-proofs.json. Source uses PlainButtonStyle and disabled around the painted label. Original host code has no parent opacity or substitute button style; observer owns surrounding background only.
failure_causes.uncertainty: The exact SwiftUI alpha implementation was not instrumented. Disabled appearance is a source-supported mechanism consistent with the original pixels; ownership and actual surface mismatch establish the product attribution. Native numeric status remains authoritative irrespective of cause.

outside_selected_ledger.observation: Both sources show one column for iOS P1 at native offered width390, canvas width358 and actual dynamic_type large. The independent brief calls for two columns for child width at least320 with ordinary large text.
outside_selected_ledger.interpretation: This is a visible full-brief grid discrepancy. Column count is explicitly excluded from the selected ledger, so it is not converted into a wrapping or overlap failure. The cause is unresolved: production code conditions columns on measured width and legacy sizeCategory, while the observer applies dynamicTypeSize; the relevant internal measured width/sizeCategory values are not recorded. Do not infer full-brief acceptance from the selected qualitative true results.

bindings: All 56 states have exact native state/input/process/event identities and complete gap-free interval union. Replacement advances fixture0 to fixture1 without business callbacks, retains observer process/instance, clears unavailable a selection, closes guidance, updates notice/reason, and permits selecting/reserving b. Taps show demonstrated native dispatch; blocked disabled c was not dispatched. Callback observations were not inferred from labels.
self_check: Eight acceptance.evaluate calls, once per delivered case, passed this same own request as both first/second solely for schema/identity checking and authoritative native/pixel recomputation. Outputs under schema-self-checks are not independent consensus or human gold. No actual decision was revised to obtain a successful schema result.
disagreement: No other judge output was accessed; cross-judge disagreement is unknown and must be calculated only after independently sealed reviews. No adjudication/consensus claim is made here.
rejected_inspection_attempts: Oversized read/projection outputs were unusable due tool truncation; distinct diagnostic records are retained under rejected-attempts. One alternate nonexistent evaluator path returned exit2; the actual approved candidate-v8 path was found directly.
